title: error.rs: Parse/InvalidArgument/MethodNotFound wrap raw String — loses call-site context
description: error.rs: ClientError::Parse(String), InvalidArgument(String), InvalidSession(String), MethodNotFound(String) wrap a human-readable string but lose machine-readable structure. A caller who wants to retry only on MethodNotFound cannot extract the missing call_id without parsing the string. Idiomatic library error enums carry structured fields (e.g. MethodNotFound { call_id: String }) so callers can match and introspect without string parsing. The #[non_exhaustive] attribute is present (good), but the payloads are still stringly-typed.
